lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Dense clusters of high-luminance circular spots arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows, specifically visible in the mid-lateral section posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of lighter intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, creating a lattice-like visual structure, most prominent in the upper-mid section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by highlights on the upper edges and shadows on the lower edges.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct reddish, high-saturation lesion or irritation is visible at the leading edge base of the right pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density spotting on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin; presence of multiple commensal fish visible beneath the ventral profile.
